verdict.rationale: Ollama's own chat app and CLI let a user chat with local models, and a hands-on report says multimodal input works, so users can feed in their own content and get AI-generated responses. There is no documented feature that analyzes data held in the product and surfaces proactive insights or suggestions. missing for 10: documented in-product analysis of user data, proactive insight/suggestion features, first-party docs describing data-grounded insights, independent corroboration of such a workflow

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Multimodal and Markdown support works as expected.
Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine.
